THE TOWN HALL · FIELD NOTES

BEFORE YOU CHARGE INTO BATTLE

A LITTLE
FIELD INTEL.

Elevate 3.0 is the third edition of our annual hackathon and business pitching competition. This time, we’re bringing the spirit of Clash of Clans with us.

DATES & VENUERevealing soon.

The full schedule, rules, and rewards are on their way.

Which battle should I choose?+

Choose Neural Nexus to build with AI and machine learning. Choose Startush Smackdown to shape a business idea and make a compelling pitch. Eligibility and participation rules will be confirmed before registrations open.

When and where is Elevate 3.0?+

The dates, venue, and event format are being finalized. Confirmed details and the complete event schedule will be published here.

Do I need to play Clash of Clans?+

The game inspires the theme. The competitions focus on building solutions and pitching business ideas. You can explore Elevate without any game knowledge; the full competition rules are coming soon.

Can I enter without a team?+

Team sizes, solo participation, and team formation options will be announced in the competition guidelines before registrations open.

What are the challenges and prizes?+

Challenge themes, judging criteria, rewards, and prize details haven’t been announced yet. We’ll publish confirmed information here.

How can I register?+

Registrations haven’t opened yet. The sign-up link, deadline, eligibility, and any entry fees will be shared here once confirmed.
